item.title: Pond 0.2.0
item.description:
Search

  • The picture model is downloaded by Pond, not built into the app (the download is about 350 MB smaller): on first run, the version pond.camera names, signed by Pond's own key and checked before it's used. Pond checks once a week for a new version (Settings › General: Download picture model updates, and Check for Updates), and while a new one indexes every event again, search keeps finding them all.

Updates

  • Pond updates itself (Sparkle): Pond › Check for Updates…, and checking daily by itself (Settings › Advanced). An update is installed only if it's signed with Pond's update key and Developer ID; after one, the recorder starts again on the new copy.

Making Pond

  • The models aren't in the repository: builds download the published ones by their locks, checked by hash (YOLO26 with its source, as its licence asks).
  • Releases from a tag on CI, or made and published on a Mac when CI can't (make publish).
